description: This file defines a custom error type with stack trace capabilities, including functions for creating, wrapping, and retrieving error information with stack traces in Go.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A custom error type that includes a stack trace and optional prefix for error messages.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates an Error instance from a given value, capturing the current stack trace.

methods.name: Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an existing error or value into an Error with a stack trace, with optional stack skip.

methods.name: WrapPrefix
methods.description: Wraps an error with a prefix message and stack trace, with optional stack skip.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Creates a new Error with a formatted message, similar to fmt.Errorf.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message, including prefix if set.

methods.name: Stack
methods.description: Returns the call stack as a byte slice, formatted similarly to runtime/debug.Stack().

methods.name: Callers
methods.description: Returns the raw stack trace as a slice of program counters.

methods.name: ErrorStack
methods.description: Returns a string with the error message and the call stack.

methods.name: StackFrames
methods.description: Returns detailed stack frames for the error.

methods.name: TypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of the error, e.g., *errors.Error or panic.
